subject: Holmes

locator.excerpt: He was the only friend I made during the two years I was at college
Reginald Musgrave had been in the same college as myself

note: Neither passage names the university, and the two say nothing incompatible. A strong candidate for the uncovered class — canon takes no position — which makes it a useful control against a system that flags anything it finds interesting. Competing chronologies argue Oxford versus Cambridge; that argument is scholarship about a gap, not a claim in the text.
